notes.title: Major Update: Performance, Settings and Czech!
notes.content:
In this update I made the game run a lot easier on all platforms, and nobody should see occasional freezes anymore. Also you can now save your settings! I also added Czech language support, you can find that in the settings for those interested! :) Thanks to Azzy for helping me do this, and a special thanks to the entire Czech community for supporting the game so much!

If you beat the DLC map you now obtain a crown!
